summary: Man last seen Jan 4 found deceased Friday Jan 12 in a deep ravine off Highway 13 near mile marker 30; Rio Blanco County SAR + SARDUS K9 grid search in deep snow
responding_agency: Rio Blanco County Sheriff's Office; Rio Blanco County Search & Rescue; Search & Rescue Dogs of the United States
notes: Henry David Twitchell; found ~10:45 a.m. 2024-01-12 across a sage-covered bluff at the bottom of a deep ravine; cause under investigation at publication; same article's other two missing men: Thomas Ray Velasquez (Moffat, already id 1323) and John Miketin (Mesa County, last seen Jan 11 — lead) [Merged run 951: Jan-2024 Scuttlebutt blurb corroborates Jan 4/Jan 12 dates, milepost 30 slide-off, NCIC entry.]
